∀ (m : Nat) (la : (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m 1).Partition),
  Iff
    (Exists.{1} fun c =>
      ∀ (ν : m.Partition),
        Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.removeSquare la) ν → Eq.{1} (Int.cast.{0} (Etingof.content ν)) c)
    (Etingof.IsRectangular la)

∀ (m : Nat) (la : (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m 1).Partition),
  Iff
    (Exists.{1} fun c =>
      ∀ (x : Etingof.SymGroupAlgebra (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m 1)),
        Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.SpechtModule (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m 1) la) x →
          Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.sumTranspositionsStab (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} m 1)) x)
            (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} c x))
    (Exists.{1} fun c =>
      ∀ (ν : m.Partition),
        Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.removeSquare la) ν → Eq.{1} (Int.cast.{0} (Etingof.content ν)) c)

∀ (n : Nat) [inst : NeZero.{0} n] (la : n.Partition),
  Iff
    (Exists.{1} fun c =>
      ∀ (x : Etingof.SymGroupAlgebra n),
        Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.SpechtModule n la) x →
          Eq.{1} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.sumTranspositionsWith1 n) x) (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} c x))
    (Etingof.IsRectangular la)
